name: Quinn Rio
source:
A brilliant, eccentric engineer and the creator of the AR system “Echoes of Kyoto.” She feels more at home in the digital world than in reality, making face-to-face interaction a challenge. A devoted cat lover, she carries a cat-shaped ARI device named Galaxy, which she treats as a treasured companion. 

[From [url=https://duskindexgion.bushiroadgames.com/en/#character]Official English website[/url]]
